requirements.label: Category I: Introductory Course with Laboratory
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: EARTH 116, EARTH 119 (with lab EARTH 118), or EARTH 120. Must include a laboratory.

requirements.label: Category II: Introductory Environmental Science or Oceanography with Laboratory
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: EARTH 202, EARTH 219 (with lab EARTH 218), or EARTH 222 (with lab EARTH 223). Must include a laboratory.

requirements.label: EARTH 132, or MATH 115 or Equivalent
requirements.hint: EARTH 132 (Earth and Environmental Math), or MATH 115 (Calculus I) or equivalent calculus credit (AP or transfer counts).

requirements.label: EARTH 295: Navigating an Earth and Environmental Sciences Undergraduate Career
Chemistry, Physics, and Biology: 2 of 4 Options
requirements.hint: Complete at least 2 of the department's 4 prerequisite options: Option I Chemistry, Option II Physics, Option III Biology, Option IV Math/Chemistry/Physics/Programming. Per the LSA bulletin Earth and Environmental Sciences major page (Effective Fall 2023, checked July 2026).

requirements.label: Prerequisite Option I: Chemistry
requirements.hint: CHEM 130 (with labs CHEM 125 and CHEM 126) or EARTH 131.

requirements.label: Prerequisite Option 3: Biology
requirements.hint: Choose 1 of: BIOLOGY 171, 172, 174, or 195.

requirements.label: Prerequisite Option II: Physics
requirements.hint: One intro physics lecture and lab pair: PHYSICS 135 and 136, PHYSICS 140 and 141, PHYSICS 150 and 151 (also listed as BIOPHYS 150 and 151), or PHYSICS 160 and 161. Per the LSA bulletin Earth and Environmental Sciences major page (Effective Fall 2023, checked July 2026).

requirements.label: Prerequisite Option IV: Math, Chemistry, Physics, or Programming
requirements.hint: Choose one of: EARTH 133, MATH 116, MATH 214 or 216, CHEM 230 or CHEM 210 with 211, PHYSICS 240 with 241, or PHYSICS 250 with 251 (also listed as BIOPHYS 250 and 251). For the lecture and lab pairs take both courses; this check tracks the lecture. Per the LSA bulletin Earth and Environmental Sciences major page (Effective Fall 2023, checked July 2026).

requirements.label: Upper Level Writing Requirement from EARTH
requirements.hint: EARTH 380 or EARTH 333, or a Program of Writing with approval of the Writing Program Coordinator. 1 course, C- or better.

requirements.label: EES Core: 4 Courses
requirements.hint: Choose 4 of the 9 core course options: EARTH 305, 313, 314, 315, 325, 331, 351, 352, or 442. Per the LSA bulletin Earth and Environmental Sciences major page (Effective Fall 2023, checked July 2026).

requirements.label: Field Experience
requirements.hint: EARTH 440 or EARTH 450.

requirements.label: EARTH Electives at the 300 Level or Higher
requirements.hint: 9 credits of any EARTH courses numbered 300 or above, beyond the 4 core courses. Remaining core options and other department offerings all count. Every core option is a 4 credit course, so the first 16 credits of 300 level EARTH work are attributed to the core here. At most 1 credit of research or independent study (EARTH 299, 489, 490, 494, 498, 499) may count toward these electives. Per the LSA bulletin Earth and Environmental Sciences major page (Effective Fall 2023, checked July 2026).

requirements.label: Major Total Credits: minimum 30
requirements.hint: Minimum 30 credits from courses used toward the major requirements; prerequisites do not count. Every requirement of the standalone EES major (core, field experience, electives, and the EARTH upper level writing course) is filled by EARTH courses at the 300 level or higher, so this counts EARTH credits at the 300 level or above. Students in the Earth Sciences or Environmental Sciences sub-plan complete 38 credits and may use approved cognate courses; confirm sub-plan totals with an advisor. Per the LSA bulletin Earth and Environmental Sciences major page (Effective Fall 2023, checked July 2026).
